mentions.name: Data over Lightning
mentions.description: A concept for transmitting data over a high voltage arc: initiating an arc through the air to a target device and modulating it to carry data, inspired by the 'Data over Lightning' mechanic in Half-Life 2. Not yet built; the author notes it won't work the way it does in the game and hopes to prototype it someday.
mentions.source_excerpt: Try to initiate a high voltage arc through the air to a target device, and modulate it to send "Data over Lightning", like Alyx does in Half-Life 2.
